settings.hero_body: First the full lineup. Then the little decisions: warm beside cool, tallest ears at the back, your favorite closest to you. All eight are included, so the arrangement is yours to play with.
settings.detail_title: Eight designs, down to the details.
settings.detail_body: Look closely at the embroidered faces, colorful hoods and little brown paws. Every companion brings its own silhouette to the collection you have been picturing.
settings.final_title: Start with eight. Make it yours.
settings.final_body: Bring the collection home and enjoy deciding where every companion belongs.
settings.moods_title: Pick the first spot for each one.
settings.moods_body: You get all eight, with plenty of color combinations to try.
settings.personality_title: A small ritual you can revisit.
settings.personality_body: Line them up today. Swap the pairs tomorrow. Changing the arrangement is a simple way to enjoy the whole set again without adding another piece.
settings.hand_note: Eight companions. Every pictured design included.
settings.personality_eyebrow: A small ritual you can revisit.
